resources.title: Meaning of History.
resources.description: Theme: Concept of History Class: JSS I | Content: 1. Meaning of History. 2. Differences between History and story telling e.g. History is time-based and factual.
resources.objectives: Students should be able to: 1. Explain the meaning of History. 2. Differentiate between History and story telling.
resources.activities:
Teacher: 1. Explains the meaning of History to students. 2. Asks students to read selected texts about the meaning of History. 3. Guides students to explain History in their own words. 4. Guides students to discuss the differences between History and storytelling. 5. Asks students to write the differences between History and story telling, flash cards/note books.

Students: 1. Pay attention to teacher’s explanation of the meaning of History. 2. Read the selected texts and make notes. 3. Explain the meaning of History in their own words. 4. Discuss in groups the differences between History and story telling. 5. Write the differences between History and Story telling on flash cards/note books.
resources.resources: 1. Relevant Text books 2. Video clips 3. Flashcards 4. Relevant pictures. 5. Other relevant materials.
resources.assessment: Students to: 1. Explain the meaning of History. 2. State 2 differences between History and story telling.

resources.title: Sources of History.
resources.description: Theme: Concept of History Class: JSS I | Content: 1. Meaning of sources of History. 2. Primary sources of History. e.g.  Oral traditions  Artifacts  Legends  Folklores  Archival materials etc. 3. Secondary sources of History e.g.  Text books  Journal articles and other articles  Government Publications  Biographies  Autobiographies, etc. 4. Tertiary sources of History e.g.  Students project  Bulletins  Memos, etc. 5. How to access sources of History:  Excursion to Historical sites  Exhibitions  Libraries  Cultural festivals  Museums etc.
resources.objectives: Students should be able to: 1. Explain the meaning of sources of History. 2. Identify the sources of History. 3. Explain how to access sources of History.
resources.activities:
Teacher: 1. Explains the meaning of sources of History. 2. Guides the students to identify primary, secondary and tertiary sources of History. 3. Provides students with examples of primary, secondary and tertiary sources of History. 4. Guides students to discuss the identified sources. 5. Explains how these sources can be accessed.

Students: 1. Pay attention to teacher’s explanations 2. Identify primary, secondary and tertiary sources of History. 3. Take notes as teacher provides examples of primary, secondary and tertiary sources of History. 4. Discuss the identified sources of History. 5. Explain how these sources can be accessed.
resources.resources: 1. Relevant Text books 2. News- papers 3. Archival materials 4. Websites 5. Audio Clips 6. Video Clips 7. Posters 8. Sample artifacts 9. Biographies 10. Costumes
resources.assessment: Students to: 1. Explain the meaning of sources of History. 2. Identify 3 primary sources of History. 3. Identify 3 secondary sources of History. 4. State 4 measures of accessing sources of History.

resources.title: Importance of History.
resources.description: Theme: Concept of History Class: JSS I | Content: 1. Importance of History to the: a. Individuals  Helps individuals to better understand themselves and their environment  Serves as a reservoir of knowledge b. Society  Helps to transmit culture and values.  Aids intergroup relationships. c. Nation  Promotes Nationalism and patriotism  Helps in the understanding of past and present events and personalities.  Guides future planning.
resources.objectives: Students should be able to: 1. State the importance of History. 2. Explain the importance of History to:  Individuals  Society  Nation
resources.activities:
Teacher: 1. Asks students to share their ideas on the importance of History. 2. Explains the importance of History to:  Individuals  Society  Nation 3. Writes a list of the importance of History on the board for students to copy.

Students: 1. Share their ideas on the importance of History with the class. 2. Listen carefully to the teacher’s explanations. 3. Ask questions about the lesson. 4. Copy the teacher’s list of the importance of History into their note books.
resources.resources: 1. Relevant Text books 2. Video clips 3. Relevant materials 4. Historical artifacts 5. Maps 6. Pictures of Nationalists
resources.assessment: Students to: State 2 each of the importance of History to the: a. Individu als b. Society c. Nation

resources.title: Origin and Organisa- tion of Trans- Saharan Trade.

Trade routes during Trans- Saharan Trade:  Borno-Tripoli route  Kanem Borno –Sudan route.  Kano-Fezzan route. 4. Effects of Trans-Saharan Trade:  Introduction of international trade.  Introduction of the use of camels as a means of transportation.  Introduction of slave trade across the Sahara.  Introduction of Islam and Arabic language  Encouraged interaction between North Africa and West Africa, etc.

Asks students to make a poster of the Trans- Saharan Trade routes.

resources.objectives: Students should be able to: 1. Explain Nationalism. 2. Describe the factors that contributed to Nigerian Nationalism. 3. Describe the nature of Nigerian Nationalism. 4.
resources.activities:
Teacher: 1. Explains the meaning of Nationalism to students. 2. Guides a discussion about the factors that contributed to Nigerian Nationalism. 3. Guides students to explain the various activities involved in the struggle for independence. 4. Leads students to list and explain the roles of various personalities involved in the struggle for independence. 5. Discusses the attainment of Independence in 1960 with students.

Students: 1. Pay attention to the teacher’s explanations and take notes. 2. Contribute to class discussions and ask questions. 3. Explain the various activities involved in the struggle for independence. 4. List and explain the roles of the key personalities involved in the struggle for independence. 5. Participate in the discussion on the attainment of independence in 1960.
resources.resources: 1. Relevant Text books 2. Video clips 3. News papers 4. Pictures 5. Posters. 6. Relevant pictures.
resources.assessment: Students to: 1. Explain the meaning of Nationalism. 2. Describe 2 factors that contributed to Nigerian Nationalism. 3. Describe the nature of Nigerian Nationalism. 4. List 2 personalities involved in the attainment of Nigerian’s independence and state their roles.
